```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
penguins <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allisonhorst/palmerpenguins/main/inst/extdata/penguins.csv")
```

# Graph A

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Quantitative + Quantitative", x = "Flipper Length (mm)", y = "Body Mass (g)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
# Graph B
```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Categorical + Quantitative", x = "Species", y = "Body Mass (g)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#Graph C
```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = sex)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Categorical + Categorical", x = "Species", y = "Sex") +
  theme_minimal()
```


##Exam 2##
```{r}

library(tidyverse)

apple <- read.csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kjhealy/apple/master/data/apple-all-products-quarterly-sales.csv"
)

# iPod dataset
ipod <- apple |>
  select(Period, iPod) |>
  filter(!is.na(iPod))

# iPhone dataset
iphone <- apple |>
  select(Period, iPhone) |>
  filter(!is.na(iPhone))

# left join
left_data <- ipod |>
  left_join(iphone, by = "Period")

ggplot(left_data, aes(x = Period, y = iPod)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "left join: iPod sales history",
    x = "quarter",
    y = "iPod sales (millions)"
  )
```

```{r}
#inner join instead
inner_data <- ipod |>
  inner_join(iphone, by = "Period")

ggplot(inner_data, aes(x = Period, y = iPod)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkorange") +
  geom_point(color = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "inner join: iPod sales history",
    x = "quarter",
    y = "iPod sales (millions)"
  )
```
